component.name: Neuroviewer
component.summary: Freeview-like neuroimaging viewer in pure Python

description.p: Neuroviewer opens NIfTI, MGH/MGZ, Analyze, MINC and PAR/REC volumes, FreeSurfer and GIfTI surfaces and .trk/.tck streamlines, with a main 3D view and sagittal, coronal and axial views that swap on click.
Layers keep their full affine in scanner RAS coordinates, label maps use the FreeSurfer colour table, and a tools menu builds isosurfaces, label surfaces and point clouds.
